reasons.police_report_adequate: Report is filed 2 days after the loss so it is on time and carries a number and date, but the loss date is not stated and the description is only two short lines, so detail is thin.
reasons.claim_status: The clause covers a locked boot when forced entry is shown but the receipt, usable CCTV and witness details are missing, so requesting evidence leads; the unattached clause text and unverified serial keep legal review live.
reasons.evidence_reliability: No receipt, an untimestamped lock photo, overwritten CCTV, an unchecked witness and a thin report leave the evidence weak overall.
